questions.statement: Selecting Hand In submits your completed Microsoft Teams assignment.
questions.explanation: Hand In submits the assignment; simply saving or closing it does not.

questions.stem: Which app is used for Microsoft Class Notebook?
questions.explanation: Class Notebook is part of Microsoft OneNote, also accessible through Teams.

questions.prompt: Name the four areas of the Teams screen shown in Lesson 3.
questions.modelAnswer: Posts, Files, Class Notebook and Assignments.

questions.prompt: In an email, what is the difference between To, Cc and Bcc?
questions.modelAnswer: To: main recipient; Cc: copy to keep others informed; Bcc: hides recipient addresses from other recipients.
